title: PostgreSQL and persistence
decisions: Use EF Core with Npgsql as the persistence standard.
Version migrations and run them as a controlled deployment step.
Give every module explicit ownership of its own tables.
Use short transactions with boundaries that match the use case.
Add indexes based on real queries and real metrics.
Enable PostGIS only for geospatial requirements.
Enable Row Level Security only after an explicit multi-tenancy decision.
migrationSafety: Destructive changes require an expand-contract strategy.
A logical rollback must be documented before deployment.
Backfills must be observable, restartable, and bounded.
